title: tools.yaml of a skill version
description: Which of the skill's scripts are exposed to the model as tools and how they are rendered. The panel validates it when a version is uploaded and the kernel when loading it.

format.description: Version of this schema. An incompatible change raises the number, and the kernel accepts both during the transition.

libraries.description: Python modules the scripts import outside the standard library. They have to be in the kernel image.

name.description: Name the model sees. Lowercase, digits and _ only: Strands treats - and _ as the same name, and Bedrock allows 64 characters.

script.description: Path of the script inside the version folder, always under scripts/.

input.description: JSON schema (2020-12) of the arguments. The kernel validates it before launching the script.

output.description: JSON schema of what the script writes to stdout. If present, the kernel validates it and the summary can only use its fields.

label.description: What the app renders on the tool card.

summary.description: How the result is summarised in the consolidated message; {field} comes from the output.

detail.description: What the user sees on expanding the card: the summary only, also the arguments, or also the result.

writes_files.description: After the tool, the kernel uploads the changes in the chat workspace.

confirm.description: Asks for the user's approval before each call.
